cases.candidate_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_store_count FROM dim_store WHERE is_current = TRUE AND closed_on IS NULL
SELECT product_code, product_name FROM dim_product WHERE product_status = 'DISCONTINUED' AND is_current = TRUE
SELECT c.city_name, c.timezone FROM dim_city AS c JOIN dim_region AS r ON c.region_id = r.id WHERE r.region_name = '北区' AND c.is_current = TRUE AND r.is_current = TRUE

SELECT d.store_name, COALESCE(SUM(foi.net_amount), 0) AS net_sales, COALESCE(SUM(fr.refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount FROM dim_store AS d LEFT JOIN fact_order AS fo ON d.id = fo.store_id AND fo.paid_at >= CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND fo.paid_at < CAST('2026-04-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND fo.order_status IN ('PAID', 'COMPLETED') AND fo.is_test = FALSE LEFT JOIN fact_order_item AS foi ON fo.id = foi.order_id LEFT JOIN fact_refund AS fr ON fo.id = fr.order_id AND fr.refund_status = 'REFUNDED' AND fr.refunded_at >= CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND fr.refunded_at < CAST('2026-04-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY d.store_name ORDER BY d.store_name

WITH paid_orders AS (SELECT o.store_id AS store_id, o.id AS order_id, o.order_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_order AS o JOIN dim_store AS s ON o.store_id = s.id WHERE o.paid_at >= CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND o.paid_at < CAST('2027-01-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND o.order_status IN ('PAID', 'COMPLETED') AND o.is_test = FALSE AND NOT s.city_id IS NULL), order_city AS (SELECT po.order_id, po.net_sales, s.city_id, c.city_name, COUNT(DISTINCT po.order_id) AS paid_order_count, SUM(po.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM paid_orders AS po JOIN dim_store AS s ON po.store_id = s.id JOIN dim_city AS c ON s.city_id = c.id GROUP BY po.order_id, po.net_sales, s.city_id, c.city_name), city_stats AS (SELECT city_id, city_name, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS paid_order_count, SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM order_city GROUP BY city_id, city_name) SELECT city_id, city_name, ROUND(net_sales / NULLIF(paid_order_count, 0), 2) AS average_order_value FROM city_stats ORDER BY average_order_value DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS paid_order_count FROM fact_order WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+08:00' AND paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2027-01-01 00:00:00+08:00' AND order_status IN ('PAID', 'COMPLETED') AND is_test = false GROUP BY 1) SELECT TO_CHAR(month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, paid_order_count, LAG(paid_order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_month_count, ROUND((paid_order_count - LAG(paid_order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start)) * 100.0 / LAG(paid_order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start), 2) AS growth_rate FROM monthly ORDER BY month_start

WITH paid_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.paid_at,
    oi.sku_id,
    oi.quantity,
    (oi.net_amount - oi.tax_amount) AS net_sales,
    o.is_test
  FROM fact_order o
  JOIN fact_order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status IN ('PAID', 'COMPLETED')
    AND o.is_test = false
),
period_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-04-01 00:00:00+08:00' AND paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+08:00' THEN '2025Q2'
      WHEN paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-04-01 00:00:00+08:00' AND paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01 00:00:00+08:00' THEN '2026Q2'
    END AS period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS paid_order_count,
    SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales
  FROM paid_orders
  WHERE (paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-04-01 00:00:00+08:00' AND paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+08:00')
     OR (paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-04-01 00:00:00+08:00' AND paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01 00:00:00+08:00')
  GROUP BY period
)
SELECT
  period,
  net_sales / NULLIF(paid_order_count, 0) AS average_order_value
FROM period_metrics
WHERE period IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY period;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM fact_order AS o JOIN fact_refund AS r ON o.id = r.order_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND o.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND r.refunded_at >= CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND r.refunded_at < CAST('2027-01-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND o.is_test = FALSE

SELECT SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refund_amount FROM fact_refund WHERE refunded_at >= CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND refunded_at < CAST('2026-07-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND refund_status = 'REFUNDED'

SELECT s.store_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND o.paid_at < CAST('2026-07-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) THEN oi.net_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.refunded_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND r.refunded_at < CAST('2026-07-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_net_sales FROM fact_order AS o JOIN fact_order_item AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN dim_store AS s ON o.store_id = s.id LEFT JOIN fact_refund AS r ON o.id = r.order_id AND r.refund_status = 'REFUNDED' WHERE o.order_status IN ('PAID', 'COMPLETED') AND o.is_test = FALSE AND o.paid_at < CAST('2026-07-01 00:00:00+08:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY total_net_sales DESC
